signal: Placer.ai crossed $100M ARR with 4,300+ customers and launched PinPoint data plus a government push

email.body1:
Aislinn, saw Placer.ai cross $100M ARR and roll out new lines like PinPoint and the government segment.

Growth at that pace surfaces more in-market accounts than an SDR team can research, write to, and chase by hand. Our AI SDR runs the research, writing, and follow-up autonomously, so coverage scales 3-5x per rep without new headcount.

I built a personalized signal play for Placer.ai off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Aislinn, quick follow-up for Placer.ai.

Most SDR teams cap out on follow-up volume and ramp, so accounts get one or two touches and then go quiet. The lift comes from consistent, personalized multi-touch sequencing the team doesn't have to run by hand.

Worth 15 minutes? I'll walk you through a teardown of your current outbound, three things I'd change. Our best practices alone usually lift response rates 50 to 70 percent.
email.body3:
Aislinn, last bit of proof for Placer.ai.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Placer.ai's reply rate likely compares to other scaling SaaS teams. Want to grab time so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Aislinn, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling SDR output without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Ramp and follow-up volume are real constraints, and timing matters.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your team's motion? I'll tailor it to Placer.ai either way.
